requirements.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:93 matches the contract signature; :97 no-op for null/empty/blank URL; :104-106 POSTs {content} with a 5s timeout; :125-133 builds title/message/key=value lines and truncates with multibyte-safe Str::substr to 1800; :176-184 case-insensitive sensitive-key and Bearer matching; :157-174 recursive nested redaction rendered as JSON; :108-119 logs non-2xx and caught Throwable at error level with scrub(). config/logging.php:236 sets the LOG_STACK default to daily; :244-250 adds audit (daily, audit.log, LOG_AUDIT_LEVEL info, LOG_AUDIT_DAYS 90); config/services.php:263-265; .env.example:10-18; phpunit.xml:380. The daily channel is not touched in the diff. Laravel's stock config already reads LOG_DAILY_DAYS with a default of 14, and LoggingChannelsTest asserts this.

conventions.evidence: Docs are kept in sync: new docs/ops/logging.md with a lane table and decision guide, a README.md:44 docs-table entry, a docs/ops/devops.md cross-link and CHANGELOG.md:30-32 entries under [Unreleased]. The public send() has PHPDoc (:88-92). Pest tests are in tests/Feature/Ops. The class under app/Ops is the plain service the task explicitly asks for. No Livewire, migrations or models are involved.

security.evidence: Context keys and Bearer values are redacted, including nested ones (:136-174). scrub() removes the exact URL, the URL without a trailing slash and any https://.../webhooks/... URL from exception messages before logging (:217-225). The log context holds only the status, the scrubbed title and the scrubbed exception message. The webhook URL is never logged.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Ops/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php covers: the no-op for null, empty and blank URLs (:403-414); the exact payload, method and URL (:416-431); every sensitive key, a mixed-case key, top-level and nested Bearer values, nested keys, and a readable value that stays readable (:433-479); exact 1800-char multibyte truncation (:481-491); the non-2xx error log without the URL (:493-509); and a transport exception that is scrubbed (:511-527). LoggingChannelsTest checks the daily, audit, stack and no-discord config. Weak point: the audit-write test ends with expect(true)->toBeTrue() (:563) and writes a real file.

simplicity.evidence: The class is mostly direct. stringify() (:186-205) has redundant branches: is_scalar/JsonSerializable and the final fallback both call encode(). scrub() runs two str_replace calls plus a regex where the regex alone would cover most cases.

readability.evidence: Methods are small and well named, and constants have clear names (MAX_LENGTH, SENSITIVE_KEY_PARTS). Minor inconsistency: \Stringable is fully qualified at :200 while JsonSerializable and Throwable are imported.

scope.evidence: Every file serves the task: the notifier, config, env, phpunit pin, docs, changelog and tests. Nothing wires the notifier into jobs or handlers, which matches the out-of-scope list. The only extra is a one-line docs/ops/devops.md cross-link, which is documentation that supports the task.

issues.explanation: The audit-write test only asserts expect(true)->toBeTrue() and writes to the real storage/logs/audit.log instead of checking what was written or using a temporary path.
stringify() has redundant branches: scalars, JsonSerializable and the final fallback all end in encode().
\Stringable is fully qualified while other global classes (JsonSerializable, Throwable) are imported with use statements.
The daily channel's LOG_DAILY_DAYS/14 retention is not visible in the diff. It relies on Laravel's stock config, which the new test guards.

review.summary: Adds App\Ops\DiscordOpsAlert with a config-driven no-op, JSON POST, multibyte truncation, recursive redaction and soft-fail logging with the URL scrubbed. It also adds an audit daily channel, the stack default switched to daily, env and phpunit updates, and a logging-lanes doc with a decision guide, all covered by focused Pest tests. The requirements and contract are fully met. Only minor test-quality and style nits remain, so I would approve with nits.
